findings.issue: Three near-identical loops turn species/pokemon refs into cards (dedupe, id≤10000 filter, catalog lookup, sort, map); speciesCardsForRefs also carries dead function-valued hiddenBySpecies support no caller uses.
findings.suggestion: Make the ability and type routes reuse speciesCardsForRefs (it already accepts a hiddenBySpecies map) and drop the function-value branch.

findings.issue: 810-line god file containing every route, the move-table render/sort logic and card helpers; the next feature lands on top of an already large module.
findings.suggestion: Split into routes (pokemon/moves/abilities/types) and a moves-table module; keep lib/api, lib/format, views/layout as the boundaries.

findings.issue: The same try/catch NotFoundError → 404-page boilerplate repeats in five handlers.
findings.suggestion: Handle NotFoundError once in app.onError (return c.html(notFoundPage(), 404)) and let handlers throw.

findings.issue: Unbounded process-lifetime cache keyed by URL; fine for the fixed snapshot, but unbounded memory growth if the API ever returns live data.
findings.suggestion: Add a size cap or TTL, or document the assumption that the dataset is fixed.

findings.issue: View layer imports spriteUrl from the api module, pulling the fetch/cache layer and module-level API_BASE state into rendering.
findings.suggestion: Move URL-shaping helpers (mediaUrl/spriteUrl/idFromUrl) into a standalone urls module both layers can import.

findings.issue: getEvolutionChain(species.evolution_chain.url) throws a TypeError (→ 500) if a species has no evolution_chain.
findings.suggestion: Guard with optional chaining and render an empty Evolution section.

findings.issue: Selecting a type/generation fires both 'change' (immediate) and 'input changed delay:200ms', causing a duplicate htmx request that hx-sync only partially absorbs.
findings.suggestion: Use hx-trigger='input changed delay:200ms from:find [type=search], change from:find select' or add hx-sync handling for the second request.

findings.issue: Dead exports: capitalize and catalog.byName are never used.
c.html(String(...)) wrapper around every render; the html tagged template already returns a string/Promise<string> that c.html accepts directly.
findings.suggestion: Return c.html(html`...`) directly, matching the docs.

findings.issue: valueForColumn uses methodLabel (i.e. humanize) for the damage-class column; the helper's name misleads readers.
findings.suggestion: Rename to humanize/damageClassLabel, or route through a shared label helper.

summary: A well-built Hono 4 + htmx 2 app on current, exactly-pinned stable versions: hono/html rendering, canonical htmx patterns (debounced search, hx-sync replace, fragment endpoints with HX-Push-Url), and deliberate handling of 404s, pagination bounds and fetch dedup. The debts are structural, not behavioral: an 810-line route god-file, three duplicated species→card loops with a bit of dead generality, and repeated NotFoundError boilerplate. I'd merge after one mechanical cleanup pass.
